entities.name: Han Soon-Chul
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Han Soon-Chul is an amateur boxer from South Korea who won a silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics, and competed at the 2006 Asian Games in the Bantamweight division, winning the silver medal. At the 2010 Asian Games, he won a bronze medal in the lightweight division.
